title: macOS native browser session discovery
acceptance: Clean macOS login, refresh and encrypted-session diagnosis without a legacy session or XDG workaround.

title: Frozen provider watermark strands the vector drain
acceptance: Bounded recovery with no externally invented provider mutation; exact generation and delete-absence proofs still required.

title: Completed bootstrap history, delayed visibility and overlapping retries
acceptance: Complete a real bootstrap, add, overwrite and delete corpus rows, interrupt and resume with historical batch rows and delayed provider visibility; pass every intermediate Worker receipt through the actual CLI validators, including deletion alone and deletion to an empty corpus, then verify exact reconciliation.

title: Whole-corpus pause and safe recovery availability
acceptance: Prove a bounded, documented recovery journey for a large paused corpus; do not unpause manually or promise active background bootstrap before it exists.

title: Authentication formats, refresh and account selection
acceptance: Exercise browser, account token, revoked token, expiry, conflicting environment identity and two-account selection on supported hosts.

title: Windows CLI identity, MSIX paths and PowerShell shims
acceptance: Resolve actual executable and version before and after installing into one prefix; run pasted commands with restrictive PowerShell and redirected APPDATA.

title: Source boundaries and exclusions
acceptance: Mixed-source destructive requests and all-except grants cannot cross exclusions before, during or after upgrade.

title: Passkeys, revocation, consent and single-use state
acceptance: Physical owner ceremony plus concurrent consume, failed retry, final-owner guard, both consent actions and session revocation.

title: Financial cursor and completeness claims
acceptance: Reject incomplete provider pages without advancing cursors; omitted, explicit, boundary and above-boundary limits and visible-row totals agree.

title: Exact package publication only after every gate
acceptance: Before publication: one tested package, six completed OS/Node jobs, planted traps, reviewed field evidence, immutable releases enabled and a verified enforcing workflow; no release before CI finishes. After publication, verify immutable tag and asset bytes before URL promotion.

title: Recovery evidence and D1 versus Vectorize restoration
acceptance: Disposable restore rehearsal preserves authoritative documents and rebuilds derived vectors; no live D1 export or bookmark-first recovery.

title: Windows ARM64 Node 24 physical runtime
acceptance: Run actual packaged CLI, DPAPI, login, update interruption and normal process exit on Windows ARM64 Node 24; x64 hosted CI is insufficient.

title: Actual setup wrapper and repeat-setup behavior
acceptance: Exercise the actual packed CLI with missing manifest and existing active install; error remedies must not re-pause a working Brain.

title: Honest health, version and retrieval handoff
acceptance: Record executable/package/manifest/worker/D1 versions separately; verify ingestion, paused state, backlog trend and cited retrieval, never infer recovery from HTTP 200.

title: Runbook, prerequisites and connector scope match the package
acceptance: Reconcile historical install-log sections 1, 3-7 with exact packaged commands, paid-plan failure point, supported connectors, approved folder and mail scopes, taxpayer-ID limits, deduplication, real retrieval questions and owner handoff. Unavailable sources must remain explicit.

title: Interrupted provisioning, schedules and durable credential pointers
acceptance: Interrupt each setup stage; retry an already-correct schedule; ensure manifest credential pointers resolve durably and deploy/status/source commands discover the same authorized credential. No remedy loops back into a needless pause.
